title: 2014 AMC 10B Problem 9
statement: For real numbers \( w \) and \( z ,\) \[ \cfrac{\frac{1}{w} + \frac{1}{z}}{\frac{1}{w} - \frac{1}{z}} = 2014. \] What is \( \frac{w+z}{w-z} ?\)

solutions.text:
Observe that: \[\begin{aligned} \dfrac{wz}{wz}\cdot \dfrac{\frac{1}{w} + \frac{1}{z}}{\frac{1}{w} - \frac{1}{z}} &= 2014\\ \dfrac{w+z}{z-w} &= 2014\\ \dfrac{w+z}{w-z} &= -1\cdot 2014\\ \dfrac{w+z}{w-z}&=-2014.\end{aligned}\]

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: Clear the tiny fractions by multiplying numerator and denominator by \(wz\)
Watch the sign change between \(z-w\) and \(w-z\)
